carpet.rule.safeScaffoldingBreak.desc: Require holding scaffolding or an empty main hand to break scaffolding.
carpet.rule.crafterStopsWhenOutputBlocke: Prevents a crafter from crafting when the container it faces cannot fully accept the main recipe result. Recipe remainders keep their vanilla behavior.
carpet.rule.craftableCoralBlocks.desc: Allows 9 coral fans of the same type to be crafted into the corresponding coral block, including dead coral variants.
carpet.rule.craftableCoralBlocks.conflic: Conflicting datapack or mod detected, craftableCoralBlocks has been locked to false
This rule is locked to false due to a conflicting datapack or mod
Conflicting datapack or mod removed, craftableCoralBlocks lock has been released
carpet.rule.recordWorldEventFix.desc: Fixes the issue where a music disc can keep playing after being quickly inserted into and removed from a jukebox, which may also cause overlapping disc audio. See MC-112245.
carpet.rule.spawnersIgnoreInvisiblePlaye: Normal spawners, trial spawners, and ominous trial spawners ignore invisible players when checking nearby players.
carpet.rule.disableKelpNaturalGrowth.des: Disable kelp natural growth from random ticks.
carpet.rule.disableAmethystGrowth.desc: Budding amethyst blocks will no longer generate amethyst buds or advance the growth of amethyst buds during random ticks.
carpet.rule.silkTouchBuddingAmethyst.des: Budding amethyst can be collected by using a suitable tool with the Silk Touch enchantment.
carpet.rule.silkTouchFrostedIce.desc: Frosted ice drops 1 regular ice when broken by a player using any tool with the Silk Touch enchantment.
carpet.rule.frostedIceProperToolFix.desc: Makes pickaxes the proper tools for breaking frosted ice.
carpet.rule.iceLikeMagmaBlocks.desc: Allows magma blocks broken by players with tools without Silk Touch to generate a lava source using ice-like support checks when the block below is a valid solid block or liquid block.
carpet.rule.disableNyliumDecay.desc: Crimson nylium and warped nylium will not decay into netherrack when covered by a block above.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerIgnoreThornsDamage: Bots will not take reflected damage caused by Thorns when attacking entities or players equipped with Thorns.
carpet.rule.invisibleItemFrames.desc: Allows players to right-click item frames or glow item frames that already contain an item with a phantom membrane to make them invisible.
carpet.rule.fixedItemFrames.desc: Allows players to right-click item frames or glow item frames that already contain an item with a glass pane to make them fixed; fixed frames can be unfixed by right-clicking them with an axe.
carpet.rule.easyWaterloggedBlockPlacemen: Allows players holding a water bucket in the offhand to directly place waterloggable blocks in a waterlogged state, except in dimensions where water evaporates.
carpet.rule.customEndPlatformPosition.de: Allows customizing the center position of the End obsidian platform generated when entities enter the End, while keeping the arrival position in sync.
carpet.rule.mobsSpawnWithoutSpears.desc: Prevents naturally spawned zombies, zombie villagers, husks, zombified piglins, and piglins from holding spears.
carpet.rule.carpetSingleplayerExitCrashF: Fixes a Carpet crash that can happen when leaving a singleplayer world after previously joining a Carpet server.
carpet.rule.disableIllegalTextCharacterC: Skips vanilla text character validation, allowing characters that are normally rejected, such as section signs.
carpet.rule.disablePlayerAttackingTamedM: Players cannot damage their own tamed mobs while PVP is enabled, and cannot damage any player-owned tamed mobs while PVP is disabled.
carpet.rule.phantomSpawnWarning.desc: Warns players at the start of the night when they reach the vanilla insomnia time threshold for phantom spawning.
carpet.rule.neutralPhantoms.desc: Makes phantoms neutral toward players: they will not attack players first, but will fight back when attacked.
carpet.rule.botTabListNamePrefix.desc: Add a prefix to bots in the Tab list, using & to represent section symbols.
carpet.rule.botTabListNameSuffix.desc: Add a suffix to bots in the Tab list, using & to represent section symbols.
carpet.rule.commandKillItem.desc: Registers the /killitem command for clearing item entities by radius or globally, with blacklist and named-item protection settings.
carpet.rule.commandMachineStatus.desc: Registers the /machineStatus command to save the target block state when a technical machine is shut down, and to check which machines are not currently in their saved shutdown state.
carpet.rule.machineStatusRollbackWarning: Checks saved machine states when a player enters a supported rollback command, and warns that player if any machines are not in their saved shutdown state. This rule does not block or modify rollback commands.
